entities.summary: Denmark is a sovereign nation in Northern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Copenhagen. Official languages include Danish. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy. Population: approximately 6.0 million. Area: 42,933 km². Comprehensive index for Denmark covering Viking Age (Danes, raids/trade/colonisation 793-1066), Jelling stones (Harald Bluetooth, Christianisation ~960), Kalmar Union 1397 (Scandinavia united under Denmark), Reformation 1536, Denmark-Norway union (1380-1814), Absolute Monarchy 1660, Golden Age (19th century, Kierkegaard, HC Andersen, Grundtvig), loss of Schleswig-Holstein 1864 (Bismarck), neutrality WWI, German occupation WWII 1940-45 (rescue of Danish Jews 1943), welfare state model, EU membership 1973, Maastricht Treaty opt-outs, Greenland/Faroe Islands autonomy.
